analysis.session_summary: Full trading day was led by pro-cyclical FX: NZD (+0.319%) and AUD (+0.197%) closed at their best, while CHF (-0.348%) and EUR (-0.213%) lagged. US data beats were muted and did not drive the dollar; the French services miss briefly knocked EUR/USD 8.4 pips but not the close. Several legs had no clear catalyst, leaving flow and technicals to dominate. The tape shows stretched EUR shorts via the inverted German PMI reaction and a weak CHF funding tone.

themes.theme: Commodity FX outperforms without own catalysts
themes.evidence: NZD +0.319% and AUD +0.197%, both closed at their best with no own releases.

themes.theme: European data miss but EUR weakness is mixed
themes.evidence: French services PMI miss weakened EUR 0.093%; German services PMI miss inverted to strengthen EUR 0.048%, yet EUR closed -0.213%.

themes.theme: CHF funding weakness drives high-beta crosses
themes.evidence: CHF -0.348% was weakest; USD/CHF +0.407%, NZD/CHF +0.67%, CHF/JPY -0.392%.
Flash Manufacturing PMI 56.0 vs 55.4 and Revised UoM 48.0 vs 46.3 both produced basket moves inside the noise floor.

currency_drivers.USD: Own data were muted; dollar recovered from early selling without a clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.EUR: French services PMI miss weakened EUR, while German services miss briefly lifted it.
currency_drivers.JPY: No own releases; BOJ rate-hike headlines supported an early bid that faded.
currency_drivers.GBP: UK retail sales and services PMI were muted, leaving no clear own driver.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own releases; closed at its best without a clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.CAD: No own releases; held its range and closed firmer with no clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.CHF: No own releases; early bid rejected, ended weakest among majors.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own releases; led strength and closed at its best without a clear catalyst.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD net fell 30.7 pips on EUR weakness; the 02:30-10:45 decline was partly driven by French services PMI (-10.4 pips, 30% of leg), while other legs lacked identifiable catalysts.

polarity_reads.read: Clean EUR downside: a miss weakened EUR 0.093%; no positioning distortion.
Inverted reaction: a miss strengthened EUR 0.048%, implying crowded shorts were squeezed.
USD beat was muted (basket -0.014% inside noise); market did not chase dollar strength.
USD beat was muted (basket +0.024% inside noise); sentiment beat did not alter positioning.
GBP ignored the miss (basket 0.001% inside noise); downside was already exhausted or offset.
GBP did not rally on the beat (basket 0.031% inside noise); gains were faded against EUR.

scenarios.invalidation: NZD/USD drops below 0.56985 or USD/CHF breaks below 0.82513.

risks.why_it_matters: USD/CHF closed near its range high (0.97) and CHF/JPY fell -74.9 pips; a crowded funding unwind can amplify crosses.
